record.question: The State Prohibition Council and the District Prohibition Committee shall consist of the following members namely: (i) Minister of Excise and Narcotics, who shall be the Chairman of the State Prohibition Council and the Deputy Commissioner district who shall be the Chairman of the District Prohibition Committee. (ii) Commissioner of Excise and Narcotic as Secretary of the State Prohibition Council (iii) Such number of other official or nonofficial members representing such interests as may be prescribed by the State Government.
